title: Iterative Learning Control
text: Design iterative learning controller for repetitive control tasks, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Sample time (Ts)} sets the iLC sample time, {Iteration duration (Tspan)}, {Data Type}, {ILC Algorithm} sets the iLC algorithm Model, {P-gain (gamma_p)} sets the proportional gain in model-free ILC, {D-gain (gamma_d)} sets the derivative gain in model-free ILC, {State Space Model} sets the model time domain, {A} sets the state-space model matrices, {ILC methods} sets the model-based ILC method, {ILC Gain (gamma_gradient)} sets the gradient-based ILC gain, {ILC Gain (gamma_inverse)} sets the inverse-model-based ILC gain, {Enable first-order low-pass filter} and {Filter time constant (tau)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: ILC Algorithm
params.values: ILC algorithm Model free ILC (default) | Model based ILC

params.name: P-gain (gamma_p)
params.values: Proportional gain in model-free ILC 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: D-gain (gamma_d)
params.values: Derivative gain in model-free ILC 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: State Space Model
params.values: Model time domain Continuous time (default) | Discrete time (Ts)

params.name: ILC methods
params.values: Model-based ILC method Gradient based (default) | Inverse-model based

params.name: Enable first-order low-pass filter
params.values: Enable first-order low-pass filter off (default) | on
